Class FormInfoController

java.lang.Object
com.codecraft.agora_backend.controller.FormInfoController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/formreq") @CrossOrigin(origins="http://localhost:3000") public class FormInfoController extends Object
Controller for handling formInfo/formBooking requests.
